children: Overview
China logistics platform's interim revenue for six months fell 10.9% yr/yr to RMB292.6 mln
Gross profit for the period declined 6.3% yr/yr
Loss for the period narrowed 37.3% yr/yr
Outlook
GOGOX plans to strengthen its platform ecosystem, expand its enterprise customer base and diversify value-added services
Company plans broader use of artificial intelligence and machine learning to improve operations and service delivery
GOGOX targets deeper Asia-Pacific market penetration and rollout of specialised premium offerings
Result Drivers
LOWER ENTERPRISE VOLUMES - Enterprise services revenue fell 13% to RMB203.6 mln due to lower shipping volumes from corporate clients
CHINA PLATFORM COMPETITION - Platform services revenue dropped 27% amid intensified competition and service optimisation in Chinese Mainland
LOWER EXPENSES - R&D expenses fell 84% after the prior-year period included RMB47.6 mln in costs related to a logistics business service project
